name: checksum-concurrency-implementation
details:
Complete implementation of checksum-based concurrency detection to replace mtime-based detection. Solves sequential modification detection across separate MCP server processes. Includes implementation, comprehensive testing, documentation, and validation.

Branch: feature/checksum-concurrency-detection
Design Doc: docs/CHECKSUM-CONCURRENCY-DESIGN.md

tasks.name: Implementation
tasks.details: Core implementation of checksum utilities and integration with existing locking system

sub_tasks.name: Checksum Utilities Module
sub_tasks.details: Create src/memory/checksums.ts with computeChecksum(), getCachedChecksum(), setCachedChecksum(), clearCachedChecksum(), clearAllCachedChecksums(), getChecksumCacheStats(). Use crypto.createHash('sha256') for content hashing. Store in Map<string, string> with normalized paths.

sub_tasks.name: Modify locking.ts
sub_tasks.details: Replace mtime-based detection in withWriteLock() with checksum-based detection. Read file before lock, compute checksum, compare with cache (sequential detection), acquire lock, re-read and verify checksum (concurrent detection). Add makeContentPreview() helper for error messages. Remove wasFileModified() and all mtime code.

sub_tasks.name: Update view() operation
sub_tasks.details: In operations.ts view() function: after reading file content (full read only, not with view_range), compute checksum and call setCachedChecksum(). Only cache when reading entire file to ensure accuracy.

sub_tasks.name: Update create() operation
sub_tasks.details: In operations.ts create() function: after writing file, compute checksum of written content and call setCachedChecksum(). Cache the content that was actually written.

sub_tasks.name: Update str_replace() operation
sub_tasks.details: In operations.ts str_replace() function: after writing modified content, compute checksum and call setCachedChecksum(). Cache the new content after replacement.

sub_tasks.name: Update insert() operation
sub_tasks.details: In operations.ts insert() function: after writing modified content, compute checksum and call setCachedChecksum(). Cache the content after insertion.

sub_tasks.name: Update deleteOp() operation
sub_tasks.details: In operations.ts deleteOp() function: for file deletion, call clearCachedChecksum() to remove from cache. For directory deletion, clear cache entry. For line-based and text-based deletion (file modification), cache checksum after writing modified content.

sub_tasks.name: Update rename() operation
sub_tasks.details: In operations.ts rename() function: after successful rename, call clearCachedChecksum() on source path. Don't cache destination - it will be cached on next access. This ensures no stale cache entries.

sub_tasks.name: Update TypeScript imports
sub_tasks.details: Add imports for checksum functions in locking.ts and operations.ts. Remove mtime-related imports/types if any. Ensure all TypeScript compilation errors resolved.

tasks.name: Unit Testing
tasks.details: Comprehensive unit tests for checksum utilities and modified locking behavior

sub_tasks.name: Checksum Utilities Tests
sub_tasks.details: Create test/checksum-utilities.test.ts. Test: computeChecksum() consistency (same input → same output), different content → different checksum, cache set/get/clear operations, clearAllCachedChecksums(), getChecksumCacheStats(), normalized path handling.

sub_tasks.name: Update Locking Tests
sub_tasks.details: Modify test/locking.test.ts: Remove all mtime-based tests, add checksum-based sequential modification detection tests (read file, modify externally, verify error with content), add concurrent modification tests (modify during lock wait), verify error messages include content preview with truncation.

sub_tasks.name: Update Operations Tests
sub_tasks.details: Modify test/memory-operations.test.ts: Add assertions verifying checksums cached after view/create/str_replace/insert/delete operations, test cache cleared on delete/rename, test sequential modification detection (read → external modify → write), verify error messages.

sub_tasks.name: Edge Case Tests
sub_tasks.details: Test edge cases: empty file checksums, large file handling (performance acceptable?), content preview truncation at 5000 chars, directory operations don't cache, file-not-found during checksum read, partial file reads (view_range) don't cache.

sub_tasks.name: Verify All Tests Pass
sub_tasks.details: Run npm test to ensure all existing tests still pass with modifications. Current test count: 117 tests. Verify no regressions. Fix any failing tests. All tests must be green before proceeding.

tasks.name: Integration Testing
tasks.details: Real-world multi-process testing to verify cross-process detection works

sub_tasks.name: Concurrent Access Integration Test
sub_tasks.details: Create test/concurrent-access.test.ts (or integration/concurrent.test.ts). Spawn two separate MCP server processes using stdio transport. Server A: view file (caches checksum). Server B: modify same file. Server A: attempt str_replace. Verify A receives 'File has been modified by another process' error with current contents shown. Use child_process.spawn() or similar.

sub_tasks.name: Manual Testing - Two Claude Sessions
sub_tasks.details: Manual test with two actual Claude Code sessions running in parallel. Both sessions connected to separate stdio MCP servers (different processes). Session A: read memory file. Session B: modify same file via str_replace. Session A: attempt modification. Verify error message quality, content preview, user experience. Document findings.

sub_tasks.name: Performance Verification
sub_tasks.details: Measure actual performance impact on real operations. Test with typical file sizes (1KB, 10KB, 50KB). Verify <1ms overhead for 10KB files, <5ms for 50KB files. Compare before/after if possible. Document actual performance measurements.

sub_tasks.name: Error Message UX Review
sub_tasks.details: Review all error messages with checksum mismatches. Verify: clear explanation of what happened, current file contents shown (with truncation if needed), actionable guidance (review and retry), consistent formatting with ━ separators. Test with various file sizes and content types.

tasks.name: Documentation
tasks.details: Update all documentation to reflect new checksum-based concurrency detection

sub_tasks.name: Update ARCHITECTURE.md
sub_tasks.details: Modify docs/ARCHITECTURE.md concurrency section (L60-81). Replace mtime description with checksum approach. Explain: in-memory cache per process, SHA-256 content hashing, sequential + concurrent detection, cross-process detection mechanism. Update example flows. Keep technical depth for developers.

sub_tasks.name: Update README.md
sub_tasks.details: Modify README.md Concurrent Access section. Focus on USER-FACING implications only (not implementation details): better detection of file modifications between operations, clearer error messages with current content shown, works across separate Claude sessions. Remove mtime references. Keep it practical and concise.

sub_tasks.name: Update CHANGELOG.md
sub_tasks.details: Add new entry under [Unreleased] section: CHANGED: Replaced mtime-based concurrency detection with content checksum verification for more accurate detection across sequential operations. IMPROVED: Error messages now show current file contents when modification detected. Include performance note: ~0.4ms overhead for typical 10KB files.

sub_tasks.name: Add Code Comments
sub_tasks.details: Ensure all new code has comprehensive comments following e/code protocol. Checksum functions: what they do (not how). Cache operations: intention clear. Locking modifications: explain two-layer detection (cache check + lock-wait check). Error message construction: purpose of truncation.

tasks.name: Review & Validation
tasks.details: Final review, validation, and merge preparation

sub_tasks.name: Code Review Checklist
sub_tasks.details: Self-review checklist: TypeScript compilation clean (npm run build), linting passes (npm run lint), all tests pass (npm test), no console.log debugging left, checksum cache properly cleared on delete/rename, error messages helpful and clear, e/code comments present, no performance regressions.

sub_tasks.name: Test Coverage Verification
sub_tasks.details: Run npm run test:coverage. Verify checksum utilities have >90% coverage. Verify modified locking code maintains coverage. Check that new error paths are covered. Overall coverage should remain ≥80% threshold.

sub_tasks.name: Security Review
sub_tasks.details: Review checksum implementation for security considerations: path normalization (prevent cache poisoning), checksum computation (crypto module secure), error messages (no sensitive data leak), cache size (DOS prevention - acceptable as in-memory and limited by file count). Document any considerations.

sub_tasks.name: Update Memory & Handoff
sub_tasks.details: Update project memory (short-term and long-term) with implementation details, lessons learned, testing results, known limitations. Prepare clear handoff notes for next session: what works, what's tested, what remains, how to verify functionality.

sub_tasks.name: Final Commit & PR Preparation
sub_tasks.details: Create comprehensive git commit with all changes. Commit message should reference design doc and key improvements. Ensure all new files added (checksums.ts, tests). Update .plans/ files. Stage everything. Commit to feature branch. Prepare for eventual PR to dev (don't merge yet - wait for validation).
